proposal.expected_reason: On G_dual_bottleneck the adaptive rule will produce a verified complete-batch makespan close to the 183s optimum (within a few seconds) while using far less tool time than the 9.76s CP-SAT OPTIMAL run, mirroring the F_competition pattern where adaptive achieved 65s vs 63s optimum at 0.35s.
proposal.selection_reason: Both scenarios now have CP-SAT OPTIMAL proofs (F=63s, G=183s), so makespan cannot be improved. Remaining research value is in the secondary objective: tool cost. Round-010 showed the adaptive rule on F reached 65s at 0.35s tool time (cost ratio 0.16 vs incumbent), i.e. near-optimal makespan at a fraction of CP-SAT cost. The adaptive rule has never been tested on G_dual_bottleneck, where the only rule tried is bottleneck (199s). Testing adaptive on G probes whether the cheap rule generalizes across bottleneck topologies.
